thread:
jordan: heads up — deploy-bot flagged build redwood-inference@v2.4.3 during preflight: SBOM signature missing for linux/amd64 artifact and vuln-scan returned 1 untriaged moderate (test-helper). Change window tonight 23:00 UTC. Decision needed: pin, rollback, or scoped carveout? @eva-sec @legal
samira: link to deploy-bot output?
deploy-bot: auto: preflight-check failed for artifact redwood-inference@v2.4.3
  - SBOM: signature missing (cosign metadata absent)
  - vuln-scan: 1 moderate (CVE-2023-XXXX) in test-helper (dev-dep) - untriaged
  - threshold: moderate >=1 triggers advisory only (not hard block)
jordan: exact severity is moderate but it's in a dev/test helper lib — risk might be low in prod. problem is the missing SBOM signature for the artifact origin. legal/eval wants evidence before we ship widely.
eva-sec: typo — i'm eva-sec, but yeah. Two quick asks: can we attach cosign after the fact if build system re-runs? And can we scope rollout to regions to limit blast?
prod-ops: if we do a scoped carveout, we need to know expected TPS for the canary and whether any migrations depend on the signed artifact. Also need rollback triggers defined.
jordan: re: attaching cosign — yes, we can re-sign the artifact with the same digest if provenance verified, but pipeline currently doesn't include cosign step for this branch. Rebuild would change digest which invalidates other references. So re-sign-by-digest isn't straightforward.
samira: is there a hotfix branch ready? PR #12345 mentioned a bump that removes test-helper dependency.
ejva-sec: (eva-sec) If hotfix is fast (<=3h), I'd prefer we stall global release and do a short EU-only canary in the change window while hotfix builds. We should add a security-exception to the release notes and require acceptance from security + legal to proceed.
legal: we need a short evidence note: why the signature is missing, plan to prevent recurrence, and confirmation that the untriaged CVE does not change customer data exposure. If you can provide that before 22:30 UTC we can approve a limited rollout.
jordan: proposed operational plan:
  - Option A: rollback to v2.4.2 globally (fast, safe)
  - Option B: limited EU canary (2% traffic) for 4h starting 23:00 UTC, with feature-flag disable for optional telemetry path, annotated release notes + security-exception doc, hotpatch PR queued (#12345).
  - Option C: block release until rebuild with cosign (delays to next slot).
prod-ops: prefer option B if legal ok. we'll set canary weight to 2% and monitor error rate, latency, and any security alarms. rollback triggers: error rate >0.5% OR any confirmed exploit or crash loops >0.5% of pods.
eva-sec: add these security controls before canary: feature-flag off for the path that uses test-helper; IDS alert rule covering unusual outbound requests from the canary instances; mandatory logging level increase for quick triage. Also add a log hook to capture any attempts to load that dependency.
samira: drafting release note snippet now:
```
Security exception (temporary): SBOM signature for redwood-inference@v2.4.3 delayed; one untriaged moderate CVE in a dev/test helper dependency. Rolling 2% EU canary for 4 hours starting 23:00 UTC. Mitigations: feature flag X disabled, increased logging, IDS rule enabled. Hotpatch PR #12345 queued. Approvers: eva-sec + legal. Rollback triggers: error rate >0.5% or any exploit observed. Post-incident review within 48h.
```
jordan: @legal @eva-sec can you ack that wording? need go/no-go by 22:30 UTC to meet change window.
legal: wording ok but require a short "why" line: cause = missing cosign step in branch-specific pipeline; mitigation = pipeline fix scheduled and audit ticket INC-987. Add that and i'm good.
eva-sec: ack with small edit: add "feature X disabled" explicitly in the notes. otherwise +1.
samira: updated snippet with legal note and feature mention, pushing to release-notes draft.
prod-ops: i'll schedule the canary rollout in deploybot for 23:00 UTC with the following params: region=EU, weight=2%, duration=4h, health-checks=[latency, error-rate, p95], rollback-triggers set as above. Also adding a manual hold at T+2h for security to inspect logs.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout for redwood-inference@v2.4.3 -> EU canary 2% at 2024-12-03T23:00:00Z (job id rb-87321). Manual hold at +2h enabled.
jordan: thanks. one more: label this release with tag "security-exception:sbom-missing" in release metadata so downstream teams see it.
prod-ops: done — tag applied and release notes updated.
samira: sending the evidence packet to legal (build logs + dependency tree + vuln-scan output).
legal: received — reviewing. will confirm by 22:25 UTC.
eva-sec: i'll stand by to flip feature flag if anything odd.
prod-ops: team on call for the window: @ops-oncall, @sre-oncall.
jordan: final ack: if legal approves by 22:25 we'll proceed with canary. If not, we rollback to v2.4.2.
legal: approved at 22:23 UTC — limited EU canary allowed with the mitigations documented.
jordan: deploy proceeding. thanks all. :thumbsup:
prod-ops: monitoring dashboard link: https://monitoring.internal/rb-87321
deploy-bot: status: canary started. job rb-87321 -> 2% EU
prod-ops: 23:15 UTC update: no errors, increased logging verified, IDS rule firing baseline only.
samira: hotpatch build passed smoke tests, slotting PR #12345 for quick merge after canary.
prod-ops: 2h hold reached, security inspection green. continuing to 4h end.
prod-ops: 03:05 UTC final: canary ended, no anomalies, escalating to gradual global rollout next change window unless security requests otherwise.
jordan: marking thread resolved; file the post-deploy review and attach timeline + evidence (postmortem due 48h).
legal: will add closing note once we have postmortem.
eva-sec: nice run — lesson: add cosign step to branch pipelines.
deploy-bot: auto: please file audit ticket INC-987 for pipeline cosign fix if not already created.
jordan: created INC-987 and assigned to eng-infra. done.
